Card Q&A.a: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also includes the [Leomon] name. This (Rule) allows this card to be chosen for text that specifies cards with [Leomon] in their names. This (Rule) does not allow this card to be chosen for text that specifies cards with the name [Leomon].
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "Treat this card/Digimon as if it also has [Leomon] in its name" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as having [Leomon].")

Effect: Treat this card/Digimon as if it also has [Leomon] in its name.
[All Turns] When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, you may play 1 [Leomon] from this Digimon’s digivolution cards without paying its memory cost.
